Game rule (P6, D-036) for goods-line route rt-dg-ce323-fringe: OSM tags this node railway=switch but states neither its type nor its lie, so both are authored for play. Simple points; toe facing for a northbound train on the Up & Down Goods (osm-n3655485894 side), oriented by the I-004 geometric heuristic (INFERRED_BEHAVIOUR I-012, I-014). Normal = the Down Goods leg, reverse = the Up Goods leg, by game convention. The real lie is unknown. Only the normal leg is used by any route: OSM gives the Down Goods (way 238611573) railway:preferred_direction=forward, running northwards from this node, and the Up Goods (way 238613009) forward running southwards into it.
